result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.has_edge()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Check if an edge exists between two nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L3529-L3583){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.has_edge( source, target, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} For undirected graphs, the order of source and target doesn't matter. For directed graphs, checks specifically for an edge from source to target. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Source node ID or label. [target]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Target node ID or label. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `True` if at least one edge exists between the nodes, `False` otherwise. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} In a directed graph, only the edge's actual direction is found: ::: {#c48b2b65 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") ) graph.has_edge(source="A", target="B"), graph.has_edge(source="B", target="A") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (True, False) ``` ::: ::: In an undirected graph, the same edge is found regardless of which node is passed as `source`: ::: {#1c710f21 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") ) graph.has_edge(source="A", target="B"), graph.has_edge(source="B", target="A") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` (True, True) ``` ::: :::
